single_outlet_findings.finding: The only headline in the corpus to ignore the document release entirely and instead lead with a political attack on Mamdani — invoking Osama bin Laden — reflecting a uniquely oppositional framing absent from all other outlets.

Captures a completely off-topic headline ('EXCLUSIVE: DOJ's New Top 2A Enforcer Sits Down For First Interview Since Getting Gig') alongside the 9/11 cover-up story, indicating this index entry (idx=4) is cluster noise from the same outlet's homepage.

Only outlet to foreground the economic-reopening motive behind the cover-up ('officials seeking to reopen NYC'), contextualising the deception within an institutional trade-off between public health and economic recovery.

bottom_line: Headline coverage is nearly unanimous in framing this as official deception — 'hid', 'lied', 'caché', 'engañados', 'cover up' — rather than transparency or disclosure, while the India bucket alone pivots to political backlash against Mamdani.
